vectors.notes: fixed: A7 weight per bucket (archive-building 1.0, colour-building 1.0, object 1.0), A3 the rest, hard switch; weighted sum of min-max scores. Buckets: p(building) > 0.5 from a logistic regression on A7 vectors (penalty 0.1, 14275 gallery images, 992 query entities left out, right on tune queries: T1 98.6% of 138, T3 100.0% of 99, T5 100.0% of 443, T8 99.6% of 232, T2 nan% of 0); a building photo is archive when its chroma spread (std of Cb, Cr) is under 2.0, else colour. Weights picked from the grid by mean hit@10 over T1, T2, T5 (tune halves); G1 (archive-building 0.6, colour-building 0.6, object 0.6) split-half hit@10: T1 38.4, T2 31.0, T5 49.2; G4 (archive-building 0.8, colour-building 0.8, object 0.0) split-half hit@10: T1 47.8, T2 29.8, T5 55.1; G5 (archive-building 1.0, colour-building 0.2, object 0.0) split-half hit@10: T1 50.0, T2 31.2, T5 55.3
